heading: About the Author
name: Jerry Zachary Bannister
paragraphs: Jerry Zachary Bannister is a Nigerian statistician, data scientist and mathematics author based in Bauchi. He works as a Senior Statistician in the Directorate of Academic Planning and Quality Assurance at Abubakar Tafawa Balewa University.
He holds a bachelor’s degree in Statistics from the University of Maiduguri and a master’s degree in Statistics from Abubakar Tafawa Balewa University. He is currently pursuing a PhD in Statistics.

Jerry previously authored Mathematics for Junior Secondary Schools, published by MEG Publishers. His professional work includes statistical consultancy, data-skills training and developing learning resources. He also builds statistical and machine learning applications.

In Maths with Friends, he connects early mathematics with familiar classroom, home, market and play experiences. Through stories, pictures and practical activities, the book encourages children to explore ideas, explain their thinking and build confidence with numbers.
He is committed to inclusion and equal participation, values reflected in the book’s diverse group of children learning together.
